title: Jiangxi Chenguang New Materials Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Materials Manufacturer
content:
Jiangxi Chenguang New Materials Co., Ltd. is a listed Chinese silicon-based materials company whose official website includes aerogel as a formal product category. The company focuses on specialty silane and silica-related materials and publicly presents aerogel among its commercialized product lines.

Company Overview

Chenguang is a large-scale Chinese materials producer with public-company status and broad silicon chemistry capabilities. While its wider portfolio spans multiple silane families and related specialty materials, its official site confirms aerogel as part of its product center, indicating in-house productization rather than simple distribution.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: China with wider commercial reach through listed-company scale and industrial customer coverage.
  • Focus Areas: Silicon-based advanced materials, aerogel materials, and downstream specialty chemical applications.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel products listed within the official product center
  • Silane and silica-related advanced materials
  • Public Capacity: A dedicated aerogel output figure is not clearly disclosed on the reviewed official pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Base: Jiangxi, China.
  • International Certifications: The reviewed official pages do not clearly list detailed aerogel-specific international certifications.
  • Official Website: http://cgsilane.com/

FAQ

Does Jiangxi Chenguang New Materials manufacture aerogel products?

Its official website includes aerogel as a dedicated product category within the company’s product center, which supports inclusion as an aerogel materials manufacturer listing.

The company is broadly known for silicon-based specialty materials, especially silane-related product lines, with aerogel included as part of its advanced-materials offering.
